164726578.name: Daraxonrasib
164726578.description: Daraxonrasib, sold under the brand name Rasonque, is an anticancer medication.

168429490.name: Ga-68-Trivehexin
168429490.description: 68Ga-Trivehexin is a radiotracer for positron emission tomography , obtained by labeling the peptide conjugate Trivehexin with the positron emitting radionuclide gallium-68 .

169203122.name: TACT908
169203122.description: TACT908, also known as [2- ethyl]dimethylamine , is a serotonin receptor agonist of the indolizinylethylamine family which is under development for the treatment of cluster headaches.

900000050.name: 3F-Thozalinone
900000050.description: 3F-Thozalinone is a designer drug with stimulant effects, first reported in January 2026.

900000178.name: Ansuvimab
900000178.description: Ansuvimab, sold under the brand name Ebanga, is a monoclonal antibody medication used for the treatment of Ebolavirus infection.

900000434.name: Cellulose acetate butyrate
900000434.description: Cellulose acetate butyrate is a mixed ester thermoplastic derivative of cellulose acetate that contains both acetate and butyrate functional groups.

900000562.name: Dapagliflozin/saxagliptin/metformin

900000818.name: Fenofibrate/simvastatin
900000818.description: Fenofibrate/simvastatin, sold under the brand name Cholib, is a fixed-dose combination medication used to treat abnormal blood lipid levels when used in combination with a low-fat diet and exercise.

900001330.name: Nebacumab
900001330.description: Nebacumab is a human monoclonal antibody developed for the treatment of sepsis. It has been withdrawn in 1993 because it failed to reduce mortality in clinical trials.

900001586.name: Plutonyl fluoride
900001586.description: Plutonyl fluoride is an inorganic compound of plutonium, oxygen, and fluorine with the chemical formula PuO2F2. It was initially isolated by Alenchikova et al. in 1961.

900001842.name: Samarium oxychloride
900001842.description: Samarium oxychloride or samarium oxide chloride is an inorganic compound of samarium, oxygen, and chlorine with the chemical formula SmOCl.

900001970.name: Tanezumab
900001970.description: Tanezumab is a monoclonal antibody against nerve growth factor as a treatment for pain via a novel mechanisms different from conventional pain-killer drugs.
